findings.issue: sr39 failed on the windows resample leg of run 40781798399 (c35ffffb): exit 3 in 7.1 s but the basis did not say timed out. The case builds a first run sleeping 3 s under a 7 s deadline, so whether the deadline lands in the second run, in the first, or not at all depends on how fast the runner starts interpreters; on a loaded windows runner the first run can eat the budget.
findings.resolution: Make sr39 independent of runner speed: drive the cut-off with a witness rather than a sleep sized against the deadline (as tt3c in tools/sweep-selftests.py does), so the second run is reached and cut off on any runner; keep the assertion that one deadline covers both runs.

outcome.technical: Task tree claude-plugins-P148.2 (sibling of the project), 4 files changed, nothing committed. Finding by finding: P135-R6 fixed - the comment above PARENT_SESSION_VARS and the module docstring now say that any other CLAUDE_CODE_ name, an exported configuration switch included, is dropped on purpose, and why (a passed session variable may start the writer as a child, while a dropped switch only makes it start the way a session without that export would). They say how an operator keeps one: the settings env block (documented, not probed) or a KEEP_SESSION_VARS entry. Both places say the keep list is 'a judgement, unverified against a CLI release'. No case, since this is prose; ras30e now pins the names the comment lists. P135-R7 fixed - ras30c's kept_credentials holds all five keep names, written out in the test, plus CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX (m1 red). P135-R9 fixed - the comment gives a reason per group (parent marker; the parent's own pid/effort/project directory; the plugin's lock state), states that a plain-shell session lacks each name, and says the effect of passing each on was not probed. P135-R10 fixed on the comment side - new ras30e requires every PARENT_SESSION_VARS and KEEP_SESSION_VARS member as a whole name in the comment (m1, m2 red). The guide side is not asserted: the guide paragraph spells only CLAUDECODE, so the assertion would be red until the guide changes, and the guide is outside this task's files. P136-R1 fixed - ras31b's unrecorded list is derived from kept_decoys (names not starting CLAUDE or AUDIT_) (m3 red). P137-R17 no-change on the mechanism - HEAD already removes the TMPDIR: _run's finally calls drop_session_tmp (run-agent-session.py, _run at the end of the file), it landed in commit 9902993f, and ras52-ras58 pin it. Docstring side: added that nothing in the drive reads the .tmpdir record back and what it is for. P137-R18 fixed with the strict reading kept - the docstring tells a caller whose temp lies inside a checkout to repoint TMPDIR, and ras34 now requires the refusal's remedy text 'point TMPDIR at a directory with no .git above it' (m4 red). P137-R19 fixed - new ras59 checks that the suite's temp root has no .git above it, names the ambient TMPDIR and returns before the runs (m6: 1/2 cases, only ras59 red). P138-R14 fixed - a comment above argv += ["--append-system-prompt-file", ...] gives the probe build and date and points at the docstring; new ras50b reads the 300 chars above that code line (m5 red, ras50 stays green). P138-R15 fixed - three comments reworded: find_skills' docstring ('The resolver takes no inventory argument, so the launcher and doctor get one answer from one function'); test__doctor_policy.py above dp49 (no longer WIDER; a scan-only name does not resolve); the test__skill_places.py section is now titled 'no second mode: the scan inventory widens nothing'. GUIDE WORDING NEEDED (PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, not mine), section run-agent-session.py, near the 'nothing else is tried' sentence: (a) 'A parent temp directory with a .git above it is refused as io-error: naming it (exit 5) and telling the caller to point TMPDIR at a directory with no .git above it; nothing else is tried. The scratch keeps <TMPDIR name>.tmpdir, holding the path, which nothing in the drive reads back; the TMPDIR itself is removed when the run ends (_run's finally), whatever the outcome short of a SIGKILL.' (b) PARENT_SESSION_VARS should be spelled out as CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_PID, CLAUDE_EFFORT, AUDIT_LOCK_TOKENS, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, and KEEP_SESSION_VARS as its five names, adding: 'the keep names are a judgement, unverified against a CLI release; any other CLAUDE_CODE_ name, an exported configuration switch included, is dropped on purpose - an operator keeps one through the settings env block or a KEEP_SESSION_VARS entry.' Once the guide holds (b), ras30d or ras30e can extend the whole-name check to the guide window. Dependants: test_drive_phase (_read_text), test__doctor_policy (find_skills), tools/affected.py (_usage, _cases, _selftest) and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (exit_for, _under) use names whose signatures are unchanged, so they are still correct. The basename referrers (audit-config.schema.json, _config_rules.py, drive-phase.py, _panel_settings.py, _skill_places.py) are still correct because the module changed only in comments and docstrings, with no behaviour change. .github/sweep-costs.json is still correct: no suite was renamed, and the gate run timed test_run_agent_session.py at 6.1s. _doctor_policy.py and _skill_places.py are untouched; only their suites' comments changed. Overlap: test__doctor_policy.py is also declared by P148.7 (pending); my edit there is two comment lines above dp49. Commands: python3 tests/test_run_agent_session.py --selftest -> exit 0, 70/70. ruff check over the 4 files -> exit 0. _output_lints.prose_number_claims and house_style_violations filtered to these files -> no hits.
